title: Wire Grok Bot dedup, incremental rescan, and doctor
description:
Wire the shared frameworks into the Grok Bot adapter: dedup rules appropriate to its storage, incremental rescan, doctor checks, and meter integration so Grok Bot sessions appear in counts alongside the other sources. Privacy rules apply identically: local only, counts only.

Done when: Grok Bot appears in per-source meter output; golden tests pass; doctor reports on a real Mac with the app installed.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: BLOCKED on KDATAP-f37d2e (which is blocked on real-Mac research/capture). When the adapter exists: choose dedup keys from the researched storage semantics (buildDedupKey supports source+recordId with content-tuple fallback), wire incremental rescan via scan-state watermarks appropriate to the format (JSONL linesSeen vs SQLite createdAt floor), add Grok Bot to doctor output and to the --sources flag/config in src/sentiment/config.ts, and extend meter per-source breakdown. Privacy rules apply identically: local only, counts only — verified by privacy.spec.ts scanning src/sentiment/**.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Done (commit after 9daf7b3). Wiring complete:
- CLI: --grok-data-dir root override; --doctor reports '<transcriptBlobCount> conversation blobs of <blobCount> total' (real Mac: 9 of 20 — one blob is a replica pair of the same conversation, deduped by conversation-uuid-embedded record ids).
- src/index.ts exports createGrokBotAdapter, extractGrokBotRecords, doctorGrokBot, defaultGrokBotDataDir, decodeBlobKeyName, conversationIdFromKeyName + option/report types.
- runSentimentMeter default sources now include grok-bot; root override key grok-bot.
- Gold-label eval scans the grok-bot fixtures (5 synthetic grok-bot rows added, 100% exact match).
- README sources bullet + wiki source-table row and status line updated.
- Real-data meter (counts only): all-time grok-bot 240 human messages / 9 sessions, 2 thanks tokens, 17 f-bomb tokens; last 24h 34 msgs / 2 sessions / 12 f-bomb tokens; today 5 msgs / 0 tokens. Privacy respected: no content read into outputs.
- Tests: sentiment 15/15 suites (146), full suite 193 suites / 1577 passed / 2 skipped; lint shows only the pre-existing benchmark require() error.
